# Define helper functions used across modules
format_date_range <- function(start, end, for_pdf = FALSE) {
  arrow <- if(for_pdf) " -- " else " → "
  case_when(
    is.na(start) | start == "" ~ "",
    is.na(end) | end == "" | tolower(end) == "present" ~ paste0(start, arrow, "Present"),
    TRUE ~ paste0(start, arrow, end)
  )
}

escape_latex <- function(text) {
  # Handle NULL, NA, and empty inputs
  if (is.null(text) || length(text) == 0) return("")
  if (is.na(text)) return("")
  if (text == "") return("")
  
  # Convert to character to be safe
  text <- as.character(text)
  
  # Escape special LaTeX characters
  text <- gsub("\\\\", "\\\\textbackslash{}", text)
  text <- gsub("&", "\\\\&", text)
  text <- gsub("%", "\\\\%", text)
  text <- gsub("\\$", "\\\\$", text)
  text <- gsub("#", "\\\\#", text)
  text <- gsub("_", "\\\\_", text)
  text <- gsub("\\{", "\\\\{", text)
  text <- gsub("\\}", "\\\\}", text)
  text <- gsub("~", "\\\\textasciitilde{}", text)
  text <- gsub("\\^", "\\\\textasciicircum{}", text)
  text
}

# Set output format flags
is_pdf <- knitr::is_latex_output()
is_html <- knitr::is_html_output()

# Configuration flags for modules
show_metrics <- TRUE
show_philosophy <- TRUE
